sourceText: User (2026-07-02/03): execute the experience-layer ablation causal-validation plan milestone by milestone until all are DONE. This story is milestone M6 (plan section 13): Controlled seeded pilot — plumbing, isolation, and leakage validation + baseline-rate estimation. Exit criteria: No store-isolation breach; fixture-leakage audit passes; scorer agreement on replay; control-arm fault baseline estimated from >=15 control-arm fault-task runs and the powered N frozen at the N-maximizing baseline within its Wilson 95% CI (pilot extended if that CI is wider than 0.30 — the S7 freeze rule); campaign runner committed.
normalizedOutcome: A committed campaign runner and leakage audit exist; the pilot ran both arms over the frozen protocol corpus with real hosts in isolated store roots; the terminal shows leakage-audit all fixtures clean, pilot summary with control-arm fault runs >= 15 / voided records 0 / replay digest match, and the freeze transcript with baseline p, Wilson CI within 0.30 width, N-maximizing p*, and the frozen powered N written to n-freeze.json.
acceptanceClaim: The pilot evidence root under .lattice/experiments/experience-ablation/<experimentId>/ contains protocol.json (validated), score-records.jsonl (both arms, >=15 control fault runs, zero voided, replay byte-identical), leakage-audit.jsonl (all clean), and n-freeze.json whose frozen N equals sample-size.mjs pilotFreezeCheck output for the recorded baseline.
